summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core functionality (glob matching, rule loading, label resolution, priority handling, error cases) and proper integration testing via act harness. Tests are organized into three tiers (unit, integration via act, workflow structure), using appropriate fixtures and mocks. Minor gaps: only 3 act test cases (case1-docs-only, case2-api-and-tests, case3-priority-conflict), no explicit tests for special characters or very long paths in filenames/labels, limited concurrency/edge-case scenarios. The act harness correctly validates workflow execution and output parsing. Fixture files and workflow YAML not provided in evaluation context, limiting assessment of those dependencies. Would effectively catch most regressions if fixture data and workflow YAML are adequate.
